message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time) during the period when both cities are observing daylight‑saving time (roughly late March to late October).  
During the rest of the year (late October to late March) Los Angeles is **10 hours behind** Berlin.

So, for example, if it’s 12:00 PM noon in Los Angeles, it’s 9:00 PM the same day in Berlin.

During daylight saving: Berlin is 8 hours ahead. But we need to mention that the difference changes with DST. Provide explanation. Also mention that currently (assuming current date 2026-09-08) Berlin is on CEST? Actually, September 8 is after DST ends? In 2026, DST ends on last Sunday of October. So September 8 is still DST. So Berlin is UTC+2. Los Angeles is on PDT (UTC-7). So difference is 9 hours? Wait: Berlin UTC+2 minus Los Angeles UTC-7 = 9 hours. So Berlin is 9 hours ahead.
